subject: Request: CTO standby + briefing checklist for Asterion exec demo
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: John Miller <john.miller@asterion.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CTO standby + briefing checklist for Asterion exec demo

Hi John —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. As discussed, we want a short, focused exec demo (45 minutes) for the CIO/CTO track covering deployment, SSO/KMS, and a quick perf/cost overview. Two asks from our side:

- Can you confirm whether the CIO will attend in person or virtually?
- Would it be possible to hold a CTO standby slot (30 minutes) immediately after the demo in case the CTO or VP wants a deeper follow-up?

Proposed demo windows (all PT):
- Tue Mar 21, 10:30–11:15
- Wed Mar 22, 14:00–14:45

Attached: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.docx and an exec-briefing-checklist. The MAP includes a suggested agenda and roles. Ben, copying you to confirm coverage/backfill if we need to swap into the CTO standby. Marissa, looping you for any SLAs/entitlements notes to surface.

If those windows don’t work, send two alternatives and we’ll aim to lock one.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Schedule a quick follow-up: https://cal.redwood.com/hannah
From: John Miller <john.miller@asterion.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops <security@asterion.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CTO standby + briefing checklist for Asterion exec demo

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the follow-up and the MAP. Our CIO will be traveling on Mar 21 and unavailable that morning. The Mar 22 window looks closer, but we have a board prep conflict from 14:00–15:00.

Two items from our side:
1) Can you include our security lead (security_ops) on the call? They’ll want to review KV/retention behavior and audit log export.
2) If the CIO cannot make the primary slot, we’d like to squeeze a short CTO-only deep-dive earlier in the same week (30–45 min). Any availability Mon Mar 20 afternoon?

If Mar 22 is the only option, we can make the CIO available for the first 25 minutes and then hand off to the CTO for the remainder, but our preference is to carve a separate CTO deep-dive.

Best,
John
John Miller
VP, Infrastructure & Architecture | Asterion Systems
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: John Miller <john.miller@asterion.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, security_ops <security@asterion.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CTO standby + briefing checklist for Asterion exec demo

On Thu, 15 Mar 2028 at 09:18, John Miller <john.miller@asterion.com> wrote:
> Appreciated the MAP. Our CIO traveling...

Thanks — understood. Two options that should cover both asks:

A) Primary: Wed Mar 22, 13:00–13:45 PT — we move the demo earlier so the CIO can attend the first 30 minutes, and the CTO can stay on for the final 15 + the CTO standby immediately after (13:50–14:20).
B) Split: Mon Mar 20, 15:00–15:45 PT — CTO deep-dive (full 45); Wed Mar 22 remains the executive intro (25–30 minutes).

Security_ops — thanks for joining the thread. Attached is a brief SSO/KMS and retention summary (sso-integration-summary.pdf) that answers most common questions; we’ll keep time for a focused Q&A.

Ben — can you be our CTO standby on Mon Mar 20 at 15:00 if we go with the split option? If not, confirm Wed Mar 22 earlier time.

I’ve updated the MAP with both paths. If you confirm which option you prefer, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-demo checklist for your execs.

Thanks,
Hannah
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CTO standby + briefing checklist for Asterion exec demo

Hannah —

I can cover Mon Mar 20, 15:00–15:45 PT as CTO standby if you want the split approach. I’ll be ready to jump into the deep-dive and own the technical follow-up. Recording is fine — please get permission from Asterion for recording beforehand.

Marissa — quick check: any entitlements we should call out for the exec demo (trial limits, Dedicated capacity options) that might change the ask?

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: John Miller <john.miller@asterion.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops <security@asterion.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CTO standby + briefing checklist for Asterion exec demo

Thanks all — split approach works best for us. Confirming:

- Mon Mar 20, 15:00–15:45 PT: CTO deep-dive (CTO + our platform lead) — Ben will lead the session for Redwood.
- Wed Mar 22, 13:00–13:30 PT: Exec intro (CIO joins first 25 mins).

Security_ops: we’re OK with recording; thanks for the SSO doc, looks good. We’ll add a short compliance addendum to the MAP (I’ll send to Hannah later today).

Hannah — please send calendar invites with dial-in links and the final MAP. Also send the pre-demo checklist to the exec attendees.

John
